metadata.description: BLD — a build-and-ship toolkit for small web apps: sprint planning through deploy, plus optimizers, runtime helpers and utilities.

plugins.name: bld
plugins.description: 25 skills for taking a small web app from idea to shipped: sprint planning, scaffolding, refinement, React and Lighthouse optimization, a static security pass, SEO indexing, on-demand MCP, delegation to external coding agents, token-budget checks, deploy, handoff, copywriting, documentation and legal policies. Ships the bld-executor subagent and a PreToolUse hook that blocks AI image generation.
